apiKey.label: Anthropic API key
apiKey.hint: The association's own key, from its account with Anthropic. The AI package makes no calls without one. The key is never shown again once saved: replace it or clear it here.

model.label: Model
model.hint: The larger the model, the better its drafts and the more each call costs on the association's account.

monthlyTokenLimit.label: Monthly limit, in tokens
monthlyTokenLimit.hint: The most the AI package may use in a calendar month, counting what it sends and what it gets back. A token is about four characters of text. Once the limit is reached, the assistants stop until the next month starts. 0 stops them at once.

requestsPerMinute.label: Calls per minute
requestsPerMinute.hint: The most calls to the model the AI package makes in one minute, for the whole association.

refusals.questionInvalid: Write a question of at most {{max}} characters.
refusals.connectedApp: A connected app cannot use the AI package.
refusals.hostUnsupported: This instance of Open BRF is older than the AI package. Update it to use the assistants.
refusals.entitlementRequired: The instance holds no active licence for the AI package. Enter one on the licence screen.
refusals.providerNotConfigured: No Anthropic API key is entered. Enter the association's key in the AI package's settings.
refusals.usageLimitReached: This month's limit for the AI package is used up. The assistants work again when the next month starts, or once the limit is raised in the settings.
refusals.tooLittleLeft: Less is left of this month's limit for the AI package than one question may use, {{budget}} tokens. The assistant works again when the next month starts only if the monthly limit is at least {{budget}} tokens. A lower limit must be raised in the settings to at least that.
refusals.rateLimited: The assistant is getting too many questions just now. Try again in a minute.
refusals.providerFailed: The language model gave no answer just now. Try again later.
refusals.documentsUnavailable: The assistant cannot read the document archive on this instance.
refusals.modelDeclined: The language model declined to answer this question.
refusals.noAnswer: The assistant found no answer it could tie to a document. Ask again, perhaps more narrowly.
refusals.issueIdInvalid: Name the issue to triage by its id.
refusals.issuesUnavailable: The assistant cannot read the issue queue or the issue types on this instance.
refusals.issueNotFound: There is no issue by that id that you can triage here.
refusals.triageTooLittleLeft: Less is left of this month's limit for the AI package than one triage may use, {{budget}} tokens. Triage works again when the next month starts only if the monthly limit is at least {{budget}} tokens. A lower limit must be raised in the settings to at least that.
refusals.triageModelDeclined: The language model declined to triage this issue.
refusals.noTriage: The assistant could not put together suggestions for this issue. Try again.
